subject: planner: handle the selection between the join group (#64535)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (975c1e1c2f40…). Change is opt-in via new sysvar `tidb_opt_join_reorder_through_sel` (default OFF): `extractJoinGroup` can traverse `LogicalSelection` above a join and fold its conditions into join-reorder `otherConds`, but only when no predicate contains `expression.IsMutableEffectsExpr` to avoid semantic changes from volatile/side-effect expressions. `optimizeRecursive` now triggers join reorder only when the current node is a `LogicalJoin`, preventing reordering from non-join nodes after the new Selection traversal. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/session behavior issues found in the touched planner/sessionctx code.
